name: singlet_scalability_out_of_core_processing
title: Out-of-core and GPU execution of standard steps
description: Runs one standard step (QC metrics, normalisation, highly variable genes, PCA, kNN graph or Leiden clustering) on a dataset that may exceed memory, using a chunked, Dask or GPU route, and writes the same members as the in-memory path. Use strategy auto unless a route is required; set fidelity.reference to in_memory to compare a route with the CPU float64 reference on a subset. Reads layers/counts and the members of earlier steps; writes its outputs and, when requested, uns/fidelity_report. Do not use it to choose n_comps, the gene count or to correct batch effects; approximate routes give approximate values.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

operation.description: Standard step to run; leiden needs neighbors output and neighbors needs pca output.

strategy.description: Execution route; auto uses in_memory when the peak estimate fits RAM, otherwise a chunked route.

chunk_size.description: Rows per chunk for chunked and Dask routes; backed_chunked PCA needs chunk_size of at least n_comps.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for Leiden, approximate neighbour indices and fidelity subsets; exact routes ignore it.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, peak host and device memory and the resolved strategy without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

n_comps.description: Number of principal components k; neighbours use the first n_comps scores.

zero_center.description: Centre genes before PCA on every route; scanpy's chunked path ignores this option.

fidelity.description: Validation against the in-memory CPU float64 reference; off by default.

reference.description: in_memory computes the CPU reference and writes uns/fidelity_report.

subset_cells.description: Cells in a fixed random subset used for both candidate and reference; 0 uses all cells.

pca_rtol.description: Relative tolerance on PCA scores and loadings after sign alignment.

pca_atol.description: Absolute tolerance on PCA scores and loadings after sign alignment.

hvg_rtol.description: Relative tolerance on HVG scores; the selected gene set must match exactly.

min_recall.description: Minimum neighbour recall R@k against brute-force neighbours.

min_ari.description: Minimum adjusted Rand index between candidate and reference partitions.

options.description: Method-specific options; each object applies only to the operation of the same name.

target_sum.description: Library size each cell is scaled to before log1p.

n_top_genes.description: Number of genes selected by the seurat_v3 score.

flavor.description: Only flavour in this version; the trend is fitted across all genes.

metric.description: Distance between cells in the first n_comps scores.

algorithm.description: brute is exact; all other values are approximate and need recall checks.

resolution.description: Resolution of the modularity objective; larger values give more clusters.

use_dask.description: Distributes clustering over GPUs; requires strategy gpu_dask.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obsm/X_pca. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary with keys operation, strategy_resolved, n_cells, n_genes, wall_seconds, peak_host_gb, peak_device_gb and, when fidelity.reference is in_memory, fidelity_passed and max_errors.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_host_gb, peak_device_gb and strategy_resolved.
